challenges.defect: Quota failure and an incomplete key event made a restored draft impossible to repair or export.
challenges.fix: Keep the protected draft editable in memory, with no storage writes without ownership.

challenges.defect: Memory-only status hid malformed and oversized picker errors.
challenges.fix: Keep operation feedback visible together with persistence status.

challenges.defect: A failed download removed draft protection; follower updates lost focus; failed Git enumeration accepted empty evidence.
challenges.fix: Pure export, confirmed replacement after a granted lock and valid read, preserved focus, and checked native metadata commands.

challenges.defect: Unblurred valid fields could be lost; read retry did not recover; another valid edit could hide an invalid control.
challenges.fix: Capture valid inline edits without redraw, revalidate unreadable storage, and block success/export/save while visible macro controls remain invalid.

challenges.defect: Editing a key after an inline delay change announced the captured old delay to screen readers.
challenges.fix: Read the current model event when rebuilding the key label; verify both edit orders and invalid-delay handling.
